dedupe_keys.name: an agent based model of crowd evacuation combining individual social and technological aspects

description: Kashif Zia publishes a NetLogo crowd-evacuation model combining individual, social and technological factors. Zenodo lists one public NetLogo file under CC BY 4.0. The description says a hypothetical grid environment holds the agents and that alternative evacuation scenarios vary behavioural and technology aspects together. This model can test how information and social interaction change crowd movement during an emergency simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is a stylised grid, not a digital twin of a named station, street network or building. A limitation is that the public page does not describe the full agent rules, parameter calibration or exit capacity; conclusions from a hypothetical environment cannot be treated as measured human response. The associated paper discusses recommendations, but the model output itself was not independently tested. The NetLogo file was not downloaded or executed, and no evacuation time or crowd-density result was reproduced.
